numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Compute crystalball.sf(x, beta, m) with improved numerical precision for large x; for x > -beta the survival function should be a multiple of the normal distribution survival function.
trigger_conditions: x > -beta (Gaussian regime where SF should equal a multiple of the normal SF)
oracle_clues: PR/commit message: "This fixes the loss of precision in crystalball.sf(x, beta, m) for large x."
